messages:
auditor_mark: Hey team, ISO/SOC2 auditors want an evidence bundle that ties RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding and IAM policy authoring) to any KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events across the incident window 2025-05-20T00:00Z -> 2025-05-23T00:00Z. Need chain-of-custody artifacts, signed manifest, and a short control map to SOC2 CC6.x and ISO A.9/A.12.

emily: We can produce that. Clarifying q: include admin-console and terraform apply logs? Also want EKM/HSM audit if available?

auditor_mark: Yes to admin console and terraform. EKM if you have it; otherwise CMKs only. One bundle per prod-region or one consolidated bundle?

emily: Consolidated bundle for all prod regions is fine. Plan: export CloudTrail (eventName in Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), k8s audit (rolebinding/clusterrolebinding create/patch/delete), admin-ui audit, and terraform run logs. Correlate by time proximity (+/- 4m), token issuer (OIDC sub/iss), and request origin (IP/userAgent).

raj: Splunk snippets I'll run (prod indexes):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```

```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

```spl
index=admin_ui_audit (action=rbac_change OR action=policy_edit OR action=emergency_kill)
| table _time, user, action, details
```

emily: Correlation CSV columns: rb_time, rb_actor, rb_resource, rb_action, kms_time, kms_actor, key_id, key_alias, correlation_score, incident_id, manifest_sig_ref. We'll include scoring_rules.md describing weights (time=40, issuer=30, ip/ua=20, tf/admin_ref=10).

auditor_mark: Please annotate any ephemeral key usage (aliases like alias/ephemeral/*) and flag CreateGrant events. Also include retention notes for each log type.

emily: Staging (unsigned) bundle: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1846001111-evidence-bundle.zip. Will sign manifest.json using KMS signing key alias/audit/signing and then move to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1846001111/. Example signing flow we'll use:
```bash
aws s3 cp ./1846001111-evidence-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit/signing --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1846001111-evidence-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1846001111-evidence-bundle.zip
```

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2025-05-21T13:04Z - rollback triggered for autoscale controller. ID: INC-20250521-4
\auditor_mark: Ensure rows tied to INC-20250521-4 show who initiated RBAC rollback and whether any Decrypt/GenerateDataKey used ephemeral keys. Provide a small sanitized sample row in the README.

emily: Will include README.md with redaction policy (emails hashed, IP last-octet masked, userAgents preserved). Retention: CloudTrail 180 days, k8s_audit 90 days, admin_ui 365 days, terraform_runs 365 days. Control map will map files to SOC2 CC6.1, CC7.1 and ISO A.9.2, A.12.4.

emily: Sample sanitized row (example):
"rbac_1717002000 | carol@redwood (redacted) | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1717002045 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/84a1-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/autoscale | 0.89 | INC-20250521-4 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1846001111/manifest.json.sig"

auditor_mark: Perfect. ETA for signed bundle?

emily: ETA ~4 hours. I'll DM the presigned link once manifest.json.sig is attached. If you want EKM logs after review, ping and we'll add ekm_audit index.
\auditor_mark: Thanks, team. We'll review on arrival and follow up if we need additional context. :thumbsup:
